diagnosis: reveal_webhook_secret retrieves DeveloperWebhookConfig by endpoint_id and returns the decrypted HMAC signing secret. Because the handler does not verify whether the webhook configuration belongs to the requesting developer account, any authenticated developer can obtain signing secrets for other tenants' webhooks, enabling them to forge webhook payloads and bypass signature verification.
exploit_request:
GET /api/webhooks/7412/signing-secret/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api-platform.cloudsvc.com
Authorization: Bearer dev_account_302
Accept: application/json
